// Loading a paragraph supersedes every speculative job from the prior generation. Keep
// already published partial cache, but do not let its old coroutine continue writing.
// Clear queue synchronously before launching coroutine
// Check if already fully generated for the currently selected voice.
// A primed/cached state may have emitted READY before it was put into the
// real queue. Emit once more after enqueue so an exact-resume owner can
// resolve the freshly assigned media item.
throw e   // 取消正常传播，不当作错误（否则会把该段误置 ERROR 态）
// Publish the terminal partial state first: this call can synchronously deliver
// the exhausted segment completion when Media3 was waiting for another chunk.
// If the prefix had already drained while TTS was pending, no further
// completion callback may arrive to expose the recoverable tail failure.
// A structured clone failure is terminal for this request. In particular,
// quota exhaustion must never flow into a future fallback or prefetch branch.
// 兜底：协程结束(正常完成/取消/异常)时一定复位 loading，避免播放按钮被 isLoadingTTS 永久禁用
// （generateStandardTTS 正常播首段时已复位，这里只兜异常/取消/早退路径）
Log.d(TAG, "prefetchParagraph: using standard TTS for paragraph $index")
// A late response from a replaced page/voice cannot block the newly selected
// clone or cancel its producers. requestTts already attributes quota to its voice.
// The finally block may remove this completed job, but no new clone work may be
// 同一段若在取消后立刻以新音色重建，旧 job 的 finally 不能误删新 job。
// The successful response is billable and remains usable. Block only the next
// network generation, including the rest of a speculative prefetch chain.
private fun resolvedAudioDuration(reported: Double?, audioData: ByteArray): Double? {
private fun inferProcessedEndFromTimestamps(input: String, timestamps: List<TTSTimestamp>?): Int {
val idx = input.indexOf(token, cursor, ignoreCase = true)
if (matched < maxOf(1, ts.size / 3) || end <= 0) return input.length
// 进入流式生成：队列播空时让播放器进入"等待下一段"而非误判结束/卡住（踩坑1）
val segmentText = resolvedProcessedText(input, response.processedText, response.unprocessedText, response.timestamps)
// Update streaming state with new segment
// Preserve the unsent tail beyond this voice type's request limit.
// A tail retry may start at segment 1 or later; it still needs to start the first
// newly queued audio and release loading without replaying the completed prefix.
// READY is observable by exact-resume owners only after the segment has a Media3 id.
// 本段生成完毕：若播放器正卡在"等待下一段"，说明刚才那段是末段 → 立即收尾推进（踩坑1）
/** Keep the current paragraph selected until its missing tail can be retried. */
fun enqueue(segment: AudioSegment, autoPlayIfFirst: Boolean = true) {
/** 朗读流式：标记本段是否还会生成更多 segment（队列播空时进入"等待下一段"而非结束，踩坑1）。 */
fun enqueueSegment(segment: AudioSegment, autoPlayIfFirst: Boolean = true) {
// Write audio data to temp file
// Create media item with segment ID as mediaId for tracking
// Exact-resume callers prime a seekable queue without briefly playing from zero.
// 之前队列播空进入"等待下一段"态，新段到达 → 跳到它继续播，消除流式 gap/卡顿（踩坑1）
// The predecessor really exhausted while generation was still in flight. This seek is
// an internal zero-position continuation, not a user scrub, so preserve the proof.
// A seek changes the current item but does not leave STATE_ENDED reliably. Re-prepare
// before play so a segment arriving after the old queue tail always becomes audible.
// 回调只设一次（activity-scoped VM 跨收起/返回复用，会话延续；收起不销毁，回到 MiniPlayer 再进来不重载）
if (_uiState.value.mode == PdfMode.READ) _uiState.update { it.copy(readFinished = true, isPlaying = false) }
hlPara = idx; wordSearchPos = paraStart(idx); paraRects = highlightRects(idx); lastWordRect = null
globalPlayerState.updatePlaybackState(currentParagraphText = doc?.paragraphs?.getOrNull(idx)?.text ?: "")   // 推 MiniPlayer 字幕（当前句）
highlight = PdfHighlight(paraPage(idx), paraRects, lastWordRect))   // 保留词框：段级 state 刷新不清词高亮
)   // 激活会话 → 退出阅读器变 MiniPlayer（之前 PDF 没调，退出直接关）
playerCoordinator.open("pdf_reader") { stopSession() }   // 会话归属 PdfReader → MiniPlayer 点回正确路由 + ✕ 时停朗读&旁白
_uiState.update { it.copy(mode = PdfMode.READ, explaining = false, subtitle = null, explainFinished = false, marks = emptyList()) }
audioPlayerManager.clearQueue()   // 真停朗读 ExoPlayer（clear() 只清状态不停播放）
doc?.close(); doc = null          // 释放 PdfRenderer
loadedKey = null                  // 下次 ensureLoaded 重载
fun shouldFallback(statusCode: Int): Boolean = statusCode in 500..599
/** Cancellation is a user/playback decision, never an availability failure. */
/** Retrofit's JSON body is replayable. Never retry a future streaming/duplex body. */
val primaryBase = if (isSynthesis) router.primaryBase() else router.catalogBase()
val fallbackBase = if (isSynthesis) router.fallbackBase() else null
// A retired direct GPU IP must not hold playback for the client's global 30-second
// connect timeout. CN has no cross-region fallback and therefore keeps the normal timeout.
// 是否回退只问 router 要节点：它已经把「这条线路允不允许跨线」判完了，
// 这里再叠一个时区条件，只会让两处判断有机会不一致。
// 5xx 才回退；4xx 是请求本身的问题，换个节点同样会失败。
private fun rewrite(req: Request, base: String): Request? {
val http = throwable as? HttpException ?: return null
// captioned_speech_partly compatibility: current nodes may read voice_code rather than voice.
// Keep both fields identical, matching the verified iOS request contract.
// 注：PRD §8.1 标 stream=true，但实测当前部署后端对该请求 stream=true 直接返回 HTTP 500；
// 而 unprocessed_text 续传（PlaybackController）本身即"partly 流式"，故保持 false（已验证可用）。
val audio: String, // Base64 encoded MP3
val speaker: String? = null // Speaker code for dialogue TTS (A, B, C...)
fun provideOkHttpClient(ttsRouter: TtsEndpointRouter, sessionInterceptor: FirstPartySessionInterceptor): OkHttpClient {
// BASIC：只记请求行/状态/大小/耗时。绝不用 BODY——TTS 每段返回 base64 MP3，
// BODY 会把整段音频打进 logcat，极费 CPU/IO 且拖慢播放（曾疑似卡顿/ANR 帮凶）。
// TTS 路由：全球普通音色走专用 HTTPS 数据入口，仅网络错误/5xx 单次回退原
// 全球网关；目录、克隆音色和全部中国线路继续钉在各自原网关，绝不跨区。
